verdict.rationale: Gram supports OAuth 2.0/2.1 integration with external providers, RBAC enforced at team/server/tool level synced to enterprise IDPs, and governs upstream credentials for third-party MCP servers with shadow-server blocking — collectively enabling scoped access control for agent tool use. However, there's no explicit documentation of per-agent least-privilege token minting/vending or fine-grained scope selection at credential-issuance time; the emphasis is on gateway-level RBAC and OAuth pass-through rather than dynamically scoped credential issuance. Missing for 10: explicit per-agent credential scoping/token minting mechanism, documented least-privilege scope configuration UI, and independent verification of enforcement.
